dct_description_sm: Changes in tree growth and regeneration at northern treelines will have a great impact on future treeline dynamics (expansion, contraction, etc).  Recent findings suggest that tree responses to climate change may vary across sub-Arctic and Arctic tree stands.  The specific limitations to tree growth and regeneration, but some studies have suggested that moisture limitations may be an important environmental factor.  This study examines historic tree growth patterns and current regeneration trends at treeline sites across a climatic gradient along the northern Dempster Highway.
dct_title_s: Tree growth patterns in Arctic Yukon and Northwest Territories
